summary: Regression + upload/serve validation after VPS-friendly fallback refactor of upload_image()/serve_file(). Backend: 28/28 pytest passing including 4 new upload tests (auth required, upload→serve round-trip verifying PNG magic bytes + image/* content-type, 404 on missing file, product creation with uploaded image URL persisted and served). Object storage is working (returned path 'saojose/products/<uuid>.png', NOT 'local/...' fallback), confirming production path is intact and fallback only triggers on VPS. Frontend Playwright: home loads with new SVG logo in header (title 'São José Material de Construção | Loja de Materiais em São Luís/MA'), 24 product cards render, admin login works (JWT sj_token stored), admin/produtos page opens 'Novo produto' dialog, file upload via [data-testid='form-image-upload'] uploads image and preview renders from /api/files/saojose/products/<uuid>.png with 'Imagem enviada' success toast. Admin login logo renders correctly. Categories/products/checkout endpoints unchanged and passing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py upload_image() fallback logic is clean: try put_object → on any exception write to UPLOAD_DIR and store 'local/<uuid>.ext'. Good defensive design for VPS.
serve_file() correctly branches on path.startswith('local/') to serve from disk; still validates existence via db.files record (prevents path-traversal via storage_path lookup). Good.

Minor: serve_file returns response with media_type from stored record but for local files does not fall back on file extension if content_type missing — currently defaults to application/octet-stream which is fine.
Minor: UPLOAD_DIR is created lazily inside the except branch; consider ensuring it exists at startup so first fallback write never races. Not blocking.
Minor: no file-size limit or MIME whitelist on /api/admin/upload — admin-only endpoint so risk is low, but flag for prod hardening.
Frontend Logo.jsx SVG renders in Header/Footer/AdminLogin/AdminLayout without layout breakage (verified visually).
seed_data_creation: Upload tests created a few files in db.files + object storage (saojose/products/*.png) and one TEST_ product ('TEST_Produto Upload Image') which is soft-deleted at end of the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VPS fallback path in upload_image()/serve_file() is validated only in the happy path (Emergent storage works, so put_object succeeds and returns 'saojose/products/<uuid>.ext'). The 'local/...' branch is not exercised on this env by design — that will only trigger on a real VPS where INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL points to unreachable storage. To simulate locally, temporarily break STORAGE_URL to observe fallback. Frontend catalog route is /produtos (not /catalogo).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found; regression + upload/serve/exhibit flow all green.
